title: Small clock with VERY large numbers!
text: Small clock with VERY large numbers!. It's going to take me a while to get used to the size of the numbers, but that's not a bad thing!

product_metadata.title: SHARP Home LED Digital Alarm Clock – Swivel Base - Outlet Powered, Simple Operation, Alarm, Snooze, Brightness Dimmer, Big White Digit Display, (Black-White LED)
features: EXTREMELY SIMPLE TO OPERATE - The cool clock has been designed with absolute simplicity in mind! Easy for boys, girls, toddler, kids, teens, seniors and the elderly.

LOUD ALARM AND SNOOZE - The bedside alarm clock comes with one of the loudest alarms available which can be set at Low or High in volume. There is also a 9 minute snooze that can be continually pressed until the alarm itself is switched off

JUMBO ILLUMINATED LED DIGITS WITH HIGH/LOW BRIGHTNESS - The red numbers on the clock are very clear with extra bright quality, easy to see! If desired, there is a high/low option to set the brightness to your own personal comfort level.

AC 120V ELECTRIC POWERED, WITH BATTERY BACK UP - To power the clock, just plug the power cord into a standard US 120V outlet (do not use with 240V) and you are good to go. Use one 9V battery for back up in case of a power outage. During battery back up the screen goes blank but alarm and time settings are retained and the alarm will still sound.
